news.title: Roadzen Announces $8 Million Registered Direct Equity Offering
news.summary: Roadzen Inc. recently completed an $8 million registered direct equity offering, selling 4,705,870 ordinary shares at $1.70 each to institutional investors. The proceeds will be used for working capital, general corporate purposes, and potential debt repayment. news.title: Cboe Global Markets (CBOE) Is Up 12.6% After Record Q1 Results And Major Portfolio Shift – Has The Bull Case Changed?
news.summary: Cboe Global Markets (CBOE) reported record Q1 2026 results with revenue of US$1,272.8 million and net income of US$385.7 million, alongside a 20% workforce reduction and divestment plans for its Canadian and Australian businesses to refocus on derivatives and data. The company's recent trading update shows index options volume up 23% year-over-year, bolstering its core derivatives franchise. While the near-term outlook is positive due to strong earnings, the long-term investment narrative remains centered on Cboe's role as a high-margin derivatives and data platform, with a continued reliance on its S&P index options posing a key risk.

news.title: RenX Enterprises (RENX) asks shareholders to OK large note conversions, reverse split
news.summary: RenX Enterprises (RENX) is seeking shareholder approval for several key proposals at its 2026 Annual Meeting, including the election of directors, ratification of auditors, and several critical financial actions. The company is asking shareholders to approve the issuance of shares related to large warrant and convertible note conversions from recent private placements, which are necessary to comply with Nasdaq listing rules. Additionally, RenX is requesting authorization for a reverse stock split at a ratio between 1-for-5 and 1-for-10 to potentially increase its stock price and maintain Nasdaq compliance, and an amendment to its 2023 Incentive Compensation Plan to increase available shares for awards.

news.summary: The Rosen Law Firm reminds investors who purchased Gossamer Bio, Inc. news.title: Blackstone stock purchase may have violated New Mexico state law
news.summary: Blackstone's purchase of over $400 million worth of TXNM stock, the parent company of New Mexico utility PNM, may have violated New Mexico state law requiring regulatory approval for sales related to utility mergers. The New Mexico Attorney General and other intervenors argue the stock purchase was integrated with the merger negotiations, while Blackstone and TXNM claim it was an unrelated investment. A public hearing was scheduled for April 30th to address these arguments.
